content: AeroSound Pro customer review: The noise cancellation makes train commutes much quieter, and the ear cushions remain comfortable on long trips. Battery lasts several workdays. One reviewer wished the case were smaller.

AeroSound Lite customer review: Lightweight and easy to wear for calls. Battery life is excellent for the price. It does not have active noise cancellation, so it is less effective in loud environments.
TrailWatch 3 customer review: GPS route tracking is reliable on hikes, and the outdoor display is readable in sunlight. GPS workouts use more battery than everyday smartwatch use.
